description: This file contains translation prompt templates and helper functions for a translation system, including language labeling, prompt generation based on target language, and glossary term incorporation.

methods.name: prettyLanguageLabel
methods.description: Converts language codes into human-readable labels (e.g., 'en' to 'English').

methods.name: translationPrompt
methods.description: Builds a translation prompt based on source and target languages, selecting appropriate templates.

methods.name: buildGlossaryPrompt
methods.description: Generates a glossary section for prompts based on a provided list of glossary entries.
